summary: Budget five-mod caster Sapphire from a cheap base with two wanted suffixes: Liquid Contempt over-cap, a desecrated crit suffix, prefix annulment, spell damage prefix.

steps: Buy a cheap rare jewel with crit chance for spells + recover mana on kill suffixes and ONE prefix (~10 ex; later bases 30 ex); Sapphire inferred from the caster mods
Potent Liquid Contempt (~1.2 div) for '+1 Suffix Modifier allowed': won 2 of 3

Preserved Cranium (~2 div) + Omen of Abyssal Echoes (+ Dextral Necromancy while a prefix is open); one jewel took a crit suffix, the other hit crit chance for spells first try; on budget bases buy a new base instead of Omen of Light
Omen of Sinistral Annulment (~10 div) + Annul removes the '+1 suffix' mod; Exalt hit spell damage
Not costed (no planner target): Liquid Ferocity (~2 div), won its 50/50 first try
Stated running tally: failed base ~4 div, the hit ~4 more (8), plus the ~10 div annulment omen; finished jewels list from ~170 div
Base in Divine is derived: ~10 ex (later 30 ex) at an unstated ex/div rate

market.source: creator at upload: comparable finished jewels 'start at 170 divines'; not a trade check

factCheck.notes: Cranium 1->2 and Echoes 1->2 (his tally counts one failed base + one hit: four divs, another four, eight, the annul, ten); Exalts 1->2 ('ty exalty', plural); base ex->div rate unsourced (band widened). Upload 2026-07-03 (0.5 Runes of Aldur).
